newsitem.title: USA: First Industrial completes debt offering.
newsitem.headline: First Industrial completes debt offering.

text.p: First Industrial Realty Trust Inc said Friday its limited partnership subsidiary, First Industrial LP, completed its $250 million senior unsecured debt offering.

First Industrial also said it completed its offering of 4,000,000 depositary shares. Each depositary share represents 1/100 of a share of series B cumulative preferred stock with a liquidation preference equivalent to $25 per depositary share.
First Industrial owns, manages, acquires and develops bulk warehouse and light industrial properties in 17 major markets in the United States.
